name: Aniruddh Bhilvare
title: Staff Software Engineer
tagline: I help teams design and deliver multi-tenant SaaS backends, AI-assisted engineering workflows, and reliable enterprise platforms.
about: I'm Aniruddh Bhilvare, a Staff Software Engineer based in Gujarat, India. I help teams turn complex product requirements into maintainable backend systems, cleaner delivery habits, and software that can keep growing after the first release.

My first decade was mobile, building Android and iOS applications at Ecosmob, Netrix, and YUJ Designs, including a SIP/VoIP client for enterprise customers and a connected-vehicle app for Citroën. Since then I've worked mainly on backend and distributed systems: multi-tenant SaaS platforms, cloud services, and the data models underneath them.

At Particle41 I combine enterprise application delivery with AI-assisted engineering workflows: developer tooling, delivery automation, and practical evaluation loops that help teams move faster without losing engineering discipline. Along the way I've led teams of up to 8 engineers and set standards for system design, clean architecture, and code review.
